title: workspace.connect output
description: The resolved governed workspace connection: the exact command that opens the target (a zellij session through the host's zr wrapper, or a declared project through zed over ssh), the connection kind, and the declared host the command reaches. An unresolvable target or an offline host is a typed error, never a fabricated command.

opened.description: What opened where, when `openOn` was given (one sentence).

ownership.description: Only present for launchOwner. A service-published cgroup identity lease; every field must still match before cleanup. Recovery receipt: $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/odin-workspace-TOKEN/ownership.json; absence never authorizes adopting or killing a unit.
